spec: DESIGN.md — evidence levels; docs/research/coverage-matrix.md — the per-arrangement verification record
description: Which emulator arrangements atlas has observed on a live installation, keyed by installation kind. An arrangement's config reading is source-verified against pinned upstream either way — this file records only whether a real machine running that arrangement has confirmed the wiring end to end. An arrangement with no entry counts as unverified: nothing here is evidence by omission.

retrodeck.label: RetroDECK

verified.reference: the RetroDECK 0.10.9b installation atlas's live verification round ran against (docs/research/retrodeck-save-placement.md; per-core records in core_audit.json)

retrodeck.note: [V] Save roots, the override chain, the ES-DE catalogue and the firmware tree were read off a running installation and compared against the resolver's answers.

emudeck.label: an EmuDeck arrangement
emudeck.note: [D] Read from EmuDeck's shipped configuration upstream (settings.sh, its org.libretro.RetroArch cfg); no EmuDeck machine has been observed. Which frontend it runs is a separate open question (emulator-catalogue-unestablished).

standalone_retroarch_flatpak.label: the standalone RetroArch Flatpak
standalone_retroarch_flatpak.note: [D] The cfg location and RetroArch's own upstream defaults are source-verified; no unclaimed org.libretro.RetroArch installation has been observed.

native_retroarch.label: a native RetroArch install
native_retroarch.note: [D] The cfg location and RetroArch's own upstream defaults are source-verified; no native installation has been observed.
